name: Jabil Inc.
research_rationale: Refreshed TTM FCF and rising quarterly EPS lift the cash case, but higher net debt, cyclical EMS exposure and unverified screen earnings metrics still weaken alignment with the buy signal.

weekly_updates.summary:
Press highlights AI infrastructure demand and an upcoming quarter consensus near $4.10 EPS on ~$11.0bn revenue; Robert W. Baird trimmed its price target on 23 Nov.
Sourced TTM operating cash flow ~$2.0bn and free cash flow ~$1.37bn per refreshed financials; net debt ~$1.64bn and negative tangible book persist.
No new SEC filing bodies in the batch; the prior FY25 diluted EPS versus screen growth-yield tension remains unresolved.
